messages:
anna: Pitched a small change: show a subtle safety banner above the tokens list when any key is wide-scope. Banner idea: "Some tokens grant broad access. Review scopes before sharing." CTA: 'Review scopes'. Thoughts?

carmen: Good call. UI question: banner visible only if at least one key has >3 scopes or admin-level scope? we should avoid noise.

nate: I'd prefer a ruleset: banner shows if any token has wildcard or admin scopes OR if >50% of shown tokens have write scopes. Keep it deterministic.

design-bot: Accessibility note: banner must be focusable and announced with role=region + aria-label so SR users notice it when it appears. Also ensure CTA is keyboard-focusable.

jules: Copy tweak: make banner actionable but not scary. Draft: "Some tokens have broad access. Review scopes or limit privileges." CTA texts: Primary 'Review scopes', secondary 'Remind me later'.

rachel: Also want inline scope previews on hover for each token (tiny tooltip with friendly summary). Avoid dumping raw JSON. Lazy-load details on hover to avoid perf hits.

anna: Edge-case: bulk revoke while banner present - modal should call out which tokens triggered the banner and allow scoping changes inline before finalizing.

carmen: Accessibility microcopy: when tooltip appears on focus, SR should read the short summary then link text. Do not expose internal IDs.

nate: Implementation note: cache scope summaries per page and fetch details only when user opens Review Scopes modal.

design-bot: Empty-state microcopy suggestion: if there are no tokens, show: "No API tokens yet. Create one to start integrating." CTA: 'Create token' + small link 'Token scopes explained'. Include keyboard hint: press C.

jules: Action items: @nate add caching for scope summaries, @rachel make tooltip comps, @carmen draft banner variant copy (soft & firm). I'll prototype the banner with small animation so it doesn't surprise users.
